title: Our Approach
subtitle: A collaborative process for defining, building, and maintaining digital solutions

steps.title: Discovery & Planning
steps.description: We discuss your goals, users, constraints, and technical requirements to define an initial project scope.

steps.title: Design & Architecture
steps.description: We prepare design and technical plans appropriate to the agreed requirements and project scope.

steps.title: Agile Development
steps.description: We develop the agreed solution, sharing progress and incorporating feedback at planned review points.

steps.title: Quality Assurance
steps.description: We test agreed functionality across relevant devices and scenarios to identify issues before launch.

steps.title: Deployment & Launch
steps.description: We prepare and coordinate deployment steps defined for your project and production environment.

steps.title: Ongoing Support
steps.description: Any post-launch maintenance or support is discussed and agreed as part of the project scope.
